tools.name: lookup_provider
tools.description: One provider by NPI: the registry record, and what the public files have on them (Open Payments total, Medicare billing, OIG exclusion, Medicare clinician record, facility enrollments, claimed-page details) with the page section where each is. The result's url is the page to cite and to send readers

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Find individual providers or organizations by name, optionally within a state. Returns up to 20 matches, best first, each with its page url. Use lookup_provider on a result for the full record.

tools.name: lookup_phone
tools.description: Providers whose registry practice phone, or a phone they published on a claimed page, is this number. Any US format. Providers who asked for their phone to be withheld are not returned.

tools.name: nearby_providers
tools.description: The providers with the same specialty nearest a given provider (by NPI) or a ZIP code and specialty, by distance between ZIP code centres. Up to 12.

tools.name: list_facilities
tools.description: Medicare-certified home health agencies, hospices, hospitals, nursing homes, or HRSA health centers (FQHCs) in a state, optionally one city. Up to 50 rows with page urls; the full list and a CSV are at the state page url.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description: Which public files this data comes from, their snapshot dates, and what they do not cover.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_provider, search_providers, list_facilities · Private data: lookup_provider, search_providers, data_sources · Public sink: lookup_provider · Destructive: lookup_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_provider, search_providers, list_facilities · Private data: lookup_provider, search_providers, data_sources · Public sink: lookup_provider · Destructive: lookup_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
